v0200.honest_assessment: v0.20.0 cuts the final visible Overworld architectural residue in half by replacing Toad Town's Kakariko Weathervane Bird Spire (raw 0x53 cols 14..15 + clearing weathervane-exclusive Map16 0x41A/0x41D/0x437 rooster head & arrow tail) with a gleaming 16-bit Mushroom Kingdom Golden Super Star Monument atop a royal red velvet pedestal (visually verified on both snes_faust and cycle-accurate bsnes), and removes Vanilla Dome's lingering olive boulder halos (0x0DE654->0x36BB). An honest 2/416 (0.5%) deep structural fingerprint is still retained for ALTTP's underlying rainstorm prologue cadence and macro dungeon room layout templates so ZRI is never artificially claimed as 0.0%.
